## Highlights

- Correct Windows desktop resource and application identity to use the selected release version, including MSI ProductVersion and executable file metadata (#458).
- Route maintained desktop builds through the shared hidden, noninteractive launcher, preserve explicit development labeling and restore the original Wails configuration after each build.
- Refuse compiled PE/MSI version mismatches before packaging or upload, and keep build-pin checks aligned with the maintained launcher.
- Native attended GUI, keyring and full workstation interoperability remain untested under the standing publication waiver; automated source, package-integrity and metadata checks remain in place.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v2.0.3/CHANGELOG.md#203---2026-11-09) for every change.
